title: Nonna's Veggie Pasta Soup
subtitle: with Vegan Parmesan
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Quarter the carrot lengthwise and thinly slice. Finely chop the shallot. Cut off the baby broccoli florets, then slice the stems into 2.5cm lengths. Crush 2 garlic cloves (see Kitchen notes). Crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 1L (4 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.
Soften veggies: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook the carrot and shallot, stirring, for 4-5 mins until softened.
Add pasta and stock: Add the pasta, Tuscan seasoning and stock to the veggies and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 mins.

Add baby broccoli: Add the baby broccoli to the pasta soup and cook for a further 4 mins or until the pasta is al dente and the baby broccoli is tender (see Kitchen notes). Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the garlic and half the shredded vegan parmesan. Taste, then season with pepper.
Serve up: Divide the pasta soup among bowls. Scatter over the remaining vegan parmesan and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: We've added the raw garlic to the pasta soup just before serving to keep its flavour fresh and vibrant. If you prefer a milder garlic flavour, cook the garlic with the carrot and shallot in Step 2 instead. ~ Add a little more hot water if the soup is too thick for your liking.
